title: bufonia perennis subsp. willkommiana
intro: Bufonia perennis subsp. willkommiana, commonly known as Wild Rockrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues, and is known for its ability to soothe and calm the stomach. The health benefits of Wild Rockrose include its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help reduce swelling and alleviate pain, as well as its antispasmodic effects, which can help to relieve muscle cramps and spasms. The bioactive constituents of Wild Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
